app/auth.py\n773\t     1\t\"\"\"Sessions and CSRF.\n774\t     2\t\n775\t     3\tThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, which signs with\n776\t     4\titsdangerous). It holds only the user's id and a CSRF token. The user is\n777\t     5\tre-loaded from the database on every protected request, so deactivating an\n778\t     6\taccount ends its sessions at once.\n779\t     7\t\"\"\"\n780\t     8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n781\t     9\t\n782\t    10\timport secrets\n783\t    11\timport sqlite3\n784\t    12\t\n785\t    13\tfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n786\t    14\t\n787\t    15\tfrom app import users\n788\t    16\t\n789\t    17\t\n790\t    18\tclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n791\t    19\t    \"\"\"Raised by current_user; main.py turns it into a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n792\t    20\t\n793\t    21\t\n794\t    22\tdef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n795\t    23\t    \"\"\"Dependency: the logged-in, still-active user, or LoginRequired.\"\"\"\n796\t    24\t    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n797\t    25\t    user = users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id is not None else None\n798\t    26\t    if user is None:\n799\t    27\t        request.session.clear()\n800\t    28\t        raise LoginRequired\n801\t    29\t    return user\n802\t    30\t\n803\t    31\t\n804\t    32\tdef require_director(user: sqlite3.Row = Depends(current_user)) -> sqlite3.Row:\n805\t    33\t    \"\"\"Dependency: current_user, but 403 unless they are a Director.\"\"\"\n806\t    34\t    if not users.is_director(user):\n807\t    35\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Directors only.\")\n808\t    36\t    return user\n809\t    37\t\n810\t    38\t\n811\t    39\tdef log_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n812\t    40\t    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on login, so a pre-login cookie planted\n813\t    41\t    # by someone else never becomes an authenticated one.\n814\t    42\t    request.session.clear()\n815\t    43\t    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n816\t    44\t    csrf_token(request)\n817\t    45\t\n818\t    46\t\n819\t    47\tdef log_out(request: Request) -> None:\n820\t    48\t    request.session.clear()\n821\t    49\t\n822\t    50\t\n823\t    51\tdef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n824\t    52\t    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use. Templates call this.\"\"\"\n825\t    53\t    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n826\t    54\t    if token is None:\n827\t    55\t        token = request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n828\t    56\t    return token\n829\t    57\t\n830\t    58\t\n831\t    59\tasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n832\t    60\t    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing POST: the form's csrf_token must\n833\t    61\t    match the session's.\"\"\"\n834\t    62\t    form = await request.form()\n835\t    63\t    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n836\t    64\t    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n837\t    65\t    if not (isinstance(submitted, str) and expected\n838\t    66\t            and secrets.compare_digest(submitted, expected)):\n839\t    67\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n840\t"}]},"uuid":"50980167-1150-4cf7-8897-108b2b53dce1","timestamp":"2026-09-29T15:10:05.585Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/davelleat/.claude/projects/-Users-davelleat-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/03dcb795-0379-4d2c-bdc0-cd9944628657/tool-results/buhu7tn6o.txt","content":"=== app/content.py\n     1\t\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\n     2\tvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n     3\t\n     4\tEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\n     5\tData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\n     6\texports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\n     7\tmodule and routes, not here.\n     8\t\"\"\"\n     9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    10\t\n    11\timport re\n    12\timport sqlite3\n    13\tfrom collections.abc import Callable\n    14\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n    15\t\n    16\tfrom app import db\n    17\t\n    18\tSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n    19\t# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n    20\t# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\n    21\tAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n    22\t_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n    23\t\n    24\t\n    25\tclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    26\t    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n    27\t\n    28\t\n    29\tclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    30\t    pass\n    31\t\n    32\t\n    33\tdef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    34\t    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    35\t    if not title:\n    36\t        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    37\t    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n    38\t        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n    39\t                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    40\t    if not body.strip():\n    41\t        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    42\t    return title, slug, body\n    43\t\n    44\t\n    45\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n    46\tclass ContentTable:\n    47\t    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    48\t    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    49\t    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    50\t    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n    51\t\n    52\t    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    53\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n    54\t            return conn.execute(\n    55\t                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n    56\t                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n    57\t                params,\n    58\t            ).fetchall()\n    59\t\n    60\t    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n    61\t        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n    62\t        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n    63\t            raise exc\n    64\t        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n    65\t\n    66\t    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n    67\t               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n    68\t        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n    69\t        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n    70\t        try:\n    71\t            with db.connect() as conn:\n    72\t                item_id = conn.execute(\n    73\t                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n    74\t                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n    75\t                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n    76\t                ).lastrowid\n    77\t                if also:\n    78\t                    also(conn, item_id)\n    79\t        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n    80\t            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n    81\t        return item_id\n    82\t\n    83\t    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n    84\t               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n    85\t        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n    86\t        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. False if\n    87\t        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n    88\t        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n    89\t        try:\n    90\t            with db.connect() as conn:\n    91\t                changed = conn.execute(\n    92\t                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n    93\t                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n    94\t                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n    95\t                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n    96\t                ).rowcount == 1\n    97\t                if changed and also:\n    98\t                    also(conn, item_id)\n    99\t                return changed\n   100\t        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n   101\t            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n   102\t\n   103\t    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n   104\t        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n   105\t        return rows[0] if rows else None\n   106\t\n   107\t    def list_all(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n   108\t        return self._select(\"1\", \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n   109\t\n   110\t    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n   111\t        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n   112\t\n   113\t    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n   114\t        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n   115\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n   116\t            return conn.execute(\n   117\t                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n   118\t                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n   119\t                (status, item_id),\n   120\t            ).rowcount == 1\n   121\t\n   122\t    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n   123\t        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n   124\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n   125\t            return conn.execute(\n   126\t                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n=== app/data_bites.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n     2\t\n     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite\n     4\t(shift continuity, ADR-003); only a Director may delete one, which the routes\n     5\tenforce. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n     6\t\n     7\tPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published`, so a draft\n     8\tcannot leak through it.\n     9\t\"\"\"\n    10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    11\t\n    12\timport sqlite3\n    13\t\n    14\tfrom app.content import ContentTable\n    15\t\n    16\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\")\n    17\t\n    18\tcreate = _TABLE.create\n    19\tget = _TABLE.get\n    20\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n    21\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n    22\tdelete = _TABLE.delete\n    23\t\n    24\t\n    25\tdef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    26\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    27\t    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body)\n    28\t\n    29\t\n    30\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    31\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n    32\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n=== app/reports.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n     2\t\n     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\n     4\tdraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\n     5\tpublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\n     6\tstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\n     7\tDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n     8\t\n     9\tA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\n    10\treplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\n    11\tstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n    12\t`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n    13\t\n    14\tPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published`, so a draft\n    15\tcannot leak through it.\n    16\t\"\"\"\n    17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    18\t\n    19\timport os\n    20\timport sqlite3\n    21\timport tempfile\n    22\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    23\t\n    24\tfrom app import db, settings\n    25\tfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\n    26\tfrom app.uploads import Pdf\n    27\tfrom app.users import is_director\n    28\t\n    29\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n    30\t\n    31\tget = _TABLE.get\n    32\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n    33\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n    34\t\n    35\t\n    36\tclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    37\t    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    38\t\n    39\t\n    40\tdef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    41\t    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update` and `remove_file` apply the same rule in\n    42\t    their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n    43\t    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n    44\t\n    45\t\n    46\tdef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    47\t    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n    48\t    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n    49\t\n    50\t\n    51\tdef _write_atomically(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:\n    52\t    \"\"\"Replace `path` in one step, so a failed write never leaves half a file.\"\"\"\n    53\t    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    54\t    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, suffix=\".part\")\n    55\t    try:\n    56\t        with os.fdopen(fd, \"wb\") as f:\n    57\t            f.write(data)\n    58\t        os.replace(tmp, path)\n    59\t    except BaseException:\n    60\t        Path(tmp).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    61\t        raise\n    62\t\n    63\t\n    64\tdef _attaching(pdf: Pdf | None) -> AlsoWrite | None:\n    65\t    \"\"\"Attach `pdf` in the same transaction as the Report's row, so the body\n    66\t    and the file are saved together or not at all.\"\"\"\n    67\t    if pdf is None:\n    68\t        return None\n    69\t\n    70\t    def attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n    71\t        conn.execute(\"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ? WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n    72\t        _write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n    73\t\n    74\t    return attach\n    75\t\n    76\t\n    77\tdef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    78\t    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n    79\t    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n    80\t    if get(report_id) is None:\n    81\t        return False\n    82\t    raise ReportLocked(\"Only the Director can change a published Report.\")\n    83\t\n    84\t\n    85\tdef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n    86\t           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n    87\t    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given.\"\"\"\n    88\t    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=_attaching(pdf))\n    89\t\n    90\t\n    91\tdef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n    92\t           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> bool:\n    93\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n    94\t    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n    95\t    it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    96\t    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n    97\t                     also=_attaching(pdf)):\n    98\t        return True\n    99\t    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n   100\t\n   101\t\n   102\tdef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n   103\t    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n   104\t    with db.connect() as conn:\n   105\t        removed = conn.execute(\n   106\t            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n   107\t            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n   108\t            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n   109\t        ).rowcount == 1\n   110\t    if not removed:\n   111\t        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n   112\t    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n   113\t    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n   114\t    return True\n   115\t\n   116\t\n   117\tdef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n   118\t    \"\"\"Delete the Report and its file. False if there is no such Report.\"\"\"\n   119\t    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n   120\t        return False\n   121\t    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n   122\t    return True\n   123\t\n   124\t\n   125\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n   126\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n   127\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")\n=== app/db.py\n     1\t\"\"\"SQLite access. Every table's schema lives here, so init_db() builds them all.\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\timport sqlite3\n     5\tfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n     6\tfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n     7\t\n     8\tfrom app import settings\n     9\t\n    10\tSCHEMA = \"\"\"\n    11\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    12\t    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    13\t    email         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    14\t    name          TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    15\t    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    16\t    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    17\t    is_active     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    18\t    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n    19\t);\n    20\t\n    21\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_bites (\n    22\t    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    23\t    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    24\t    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    25\t    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n    26\t    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    27\t    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    28\t    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    29\t    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n    30\t);\n    31\t\n    32\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reports (\n    33\t    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    34\t    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    35\t    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- unique among Reports only; a Data Bite may share it\n    36\t    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n    37\t    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    38\t    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    39\t    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    40\t    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    41\t    file_name  TEXT    -- the attached PDF's sanitized name for display; NULL if none\n    42\t);\n    43\t\"\"\"\n    44\t\n    45\t# Columns added after a table was first created: (table, column, definition).\n    46\t# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an existing table alone, so init_db adds\n    47\t# any of these an older database is missing.\n    48\tADDED_COLUMNS = [\n    49\t    (\"reports\", \"file_name\", \"TEXT\"),\n    50\t]\n    51\t\n    52\t\n    53\t@contextmanager\n    54\tdef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    55\t    \"\"\"Open the database named by settings (read at call time, so tests can swap\n    56\t    it). Commits on success, rolls back on error, always closes.\"\"\"\n    57\t    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    58\t    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    59\t    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    60\t    try:\n    61\t        with conn:\n    62\t            yield conn\n    63\t    finally:\n    64\t        conn.close()\n    65\t\n    66\t\n    67\tdef init_db() -> None:\n    68\t    with connect() as conn:\n    69\t        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n    70\t        for table, column, definition in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n    71\t            existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n    72\t            if column not in existing:\n    73\t                conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}\")\n=== app/main.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n     2\t\n     3\tThe admin console lives under /admin (login required) and the public preview\n     4\tat /. Routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included here.\n     5\tKeep this file small.\n     6\t\"\"\"\n     7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     8\t\n     9\timport sys\n    10\tfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n    11\t\n    12\tfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\n    13\tfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n    14\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n    15\t\n    16\tfrom app import db, settings\n    17\tfrom app.auth import LoginRequired, current_user\n    18\tfrom app.data_bites import list_published as published_data_bites\n    19\tfrom app.reports import list_published as published_reports\n    20\tfrom app.routes import admin, auth, data_bites, reports, users\n    21\tfrom app.templating import templates\n    22\t\n    23\tSESSION_MAX_AGE = 8 * 60 * 60  # one working day\n    24\tALL_METHODS = [\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\", \"OPTIONS\"]\n    25\t\n    26\t\n    27\t@asynccontextmanager\n    28\tasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n    29\t    # At server start, not import, so importing app.main never touches a database.\n    30\t    db.init_db()\n    31\t    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER:\n    32\t        print(\"WARNING: CMS_SECRET_KEY is unset or the .env.example placeholder; \"\n    33\t              \"session cookies can be forged. Set a long random value in .env.\",\n    34\t              file=sys.stderr)\n    35\t    yield\n    36\t\n    37\t\n    38\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    39\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", lifespan=lifespan)\n    40\t    app.add_middleware(\n    41\t        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n    42\t        session_cookie=\"cms_session\", max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\",\n    43\t    )\n    44\t\n    45\t    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    46\t    def redirect_to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n    47\t        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n    48\t\n    49\t    @app.get(\"/\")\n    50\t    def public_home(request: Request):\n    51\t        # Titles only: the public pages (and links to them) arrive with the\n    52\t        # public-site ticket, T07.\n    53\t        data_bite_items = [{\"title\": b[\"title\"]} for b in published_data_bites()]\n    54\t        report_items = [{\"title\": r[\"title\"]} for r in published_reports()]\n    55\t        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n    56\t            request, \"public/home.html\",\n    57\t            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": data_bite_items,\n    58\t             \"reports\": report_items},\n    59\t        )\n    60\t\n    61\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    62\t    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    63\t    app.include_router(users.router)\n    64\t    app.include_router(data_bites.router)\n    65\t    app.include_router(reports.router)\n    66\t\n    67\t    # Must stay last: any /admin request no router above claimed, by path or by\n    68\t    # method. Anonymous visitors are sent to login (so they can't probe which\n    69\t    # admin paths exist); signed-in users get 405/404.\n    70\t    @app.api_route(\"/admin\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n    71\t                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    72\t    def admin_method_not_allowed():\n    73\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=405)\n    74\t\n    75\t    @app.api_route(\"/admin/{rest:path}\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n    76\t                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    77\t    def admin_not_found(rest: str):\n    78\t        if rest == \"\":\n    79\t            return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=307)\n    80\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    81\t\n    82\t    return app\n    83\t\n    84\t\n    85\tapp = create_app()\n=== app/templating.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The Jinja environment the admin console renders with.\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\tfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n     5\t\n     6\tfrom app import settings\n     7\tfrom app.auth import csrf_token\n     8\tfrom app.users import ROLE_LABELS\n     9\t\n    10\ttemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n    11\ttemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\n    12\ttemplates.env.filters[\"role_label\"] = ROLE_LABELS.get\n=== app/publish.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n     2\t\n     3\tT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\n     4\trender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n     5\t\n     6\t  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n     7\t  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     8\t     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     9\t\"\"\"\n    10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    11\t\n    12\timport shutil\n    13\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n    16\t\n    17\tfrom app import settings\n    18\t\n    19\tCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n    20\t:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\n    21\tbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n    22\theader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n    23\tmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n    24\t\"\"\"\n    25\t\n    26\t\n    27\tdef environment() -> Environment:\n    28\t    return Environment(\n    29\t        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n    30\t        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    31\t    )\n    32\t\n    33\t\n    34\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    35\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n    36\t    if out.exists():\n    37\t        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    38\t    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    39\t    env = environment()\n    40\t    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    41\t    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n    42\t        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n    43\t            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[], css_path=\"style.css\",\n    44\t            home_path=\"index.html\",\n    45\t        )\n    46\t    )\n    47\t    return out\n=== app/routes/admin.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The admin console. CSRF.\n     2\t\n     3\tThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, which signs with\n     4\titsdangerous). It holds only the user's id and a CSRF token. The user is\n     5\tre-loaded from the database on every protected request, so deactivating an\n     6\taccount ends its sessions at once.\n     7\t\"\"\"\n     8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     9\t\n    10\timport secrets\n    11\timport sqlite3\n    12\t\n    13\tfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom app import users\n    16\t\n    17\t\n    18\tclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    19\t    \"\"\"Raised by current_user; main.py turns it into a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n    20\t\n    21\t\n    22\tdef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    23\t    \"\"\"Dependency: the logged-in, still-active user, or LoginRequired.\"\"\"\n    24\t    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    25\t    user = users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id is not None else None\n    26\t    if user is None:\n    27\t        request.session.clear()\n    28\t        raise LoginRequired\n    29\t    return user\n    30\t\n    31\t\n    32\tdef require_director(user: sqlite3.Row = Depends(current_user)) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    33\t    \"\"\"Dependency: current_user, but 403 unless they are a Director.\"\"\"\n    34\t    if not users.is_director(user):\n    35\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Directors only.\")\n    36\t    return user\n    37\t\n    38\t\n    39\tdef log_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    40\t    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on login, so a pre-login cookie planted\n    41\t    # by someone else never becomes an authenticated one.\n    42\t    request.session.clear()\n    43\t    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n    44\t    csrf_token(request)\n    45\t\n    46\t\n    47\tdef log_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    48\t    request.session.clear()\n    49\t\n    50\t\n    51\tdef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    52\t    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use. Templates call this.\"\"\"\n    53\t    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    54\t    if token is None:\n    55\t        token = request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    56\t    return token\n    57\t\n    58\t\n    59\tasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    60\t    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing POST: the form's csrf_token must\n    61\t    match the session's.\"\"\"\n    62\t    form = await request.form()\n    63\t    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    64\t    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    65\t    if not (isinstance(submitted, str) and expected\n    66\t            and secrets.compare_digest(submitted, expected)):\n    67\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n","numLines":840,"startLine":1,"totalLines":840}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"49892264-e085-457d-82ab-ee712d126099","session_id":"fc138a42-1eee-4017-bff2-c6a77302f820","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"03dcb795-0379-4d2c-bdc0-cd9944628657","version":"2.1.284","gitBranch":"main"}

Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\"\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"4b93a593-3c47-40e0-b7c8-093950fe3e55","timestamp":"2026-09-29T15:11:39.870Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01EzGUmwykPTQ8DRTTgfHx1r","session_id":"fc138a42-1eee-4017-bff2-c6a77302f820","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"03dcb795-0379-4d2c-bdc0-cd9944628657","version":"2.1.284","gitBranch":"main"}

Admin console — dashboard, filterable content list, Markdown preview\n(issue #7).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form\n\n\ndef create(c: TestClient, kind: str, slug: str, *, body: str = \"Some **Markdown**.\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft of `kind` (\"data-bites\" or \"reports\"); its id.\"\"\"\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/{kind}\", {\"title\": slug.title(), \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body})\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return re.search(rf'<tr id=\"[a-z-]+-(\\d+)\">\\s*<td><a href=\"/admin/{kind}/\\d+\">'\n                     rf'{slug.title()}</a>', c.get(f\"/admin/{kind}\").text).group(1)\n\n\ndef publish(director: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str) -> None:\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef dashboard_counts(c: TestClient) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"The dashboard's count cells, e.g. {\"data-bite-draft\": \"2\", ...}.\"\"\"\n    return dict(re.findall(r'<td id=\"count-([a-z-]+)\">(\\d+)</td>', c.get(\"/admin\").text))\n\n\n# --- Dashboard ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_dashboard_starts_at_zero(client_as):\n    assert dashboard_counts(client_as(\"editor\")) == {\n        \"data-bite-draft\": \"0\", \"data-bite-published\": \"0\", \"data-bite-total\": \"0\",\n        \"report-draft\": \"0\", \"report-published\": \"0\", \"report-total\": \"0\",\n    }\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_each_type_by_status(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    for slug in (\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"):\n        create(analyst, \"data-bites\", slug)\n    publish(analyst, \"data-bites\", create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"d\"))\n    create(analyst, \"reports\", \"factbook\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(analyst, \"reports\", \"cds\"))\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(director, \"reports\", \"survey-calendar\"))\n\n    expected = {\n        \"data-bite-draft\": \"3\", \"data-bite-published\": \"1\", \"data-bite-total\": \"4\",\n        \"report-draft\": \"1\", \"report-published\": \"2\", \"report-total\": \"3\",\n    }\n    assert dashboard_counts(analyst) == expected\n    assert dashboard_counts(director) == expected\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_follow_unpublish_and_delete(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    bite = create(director, \"data-bites\", \"a\")\n    publish(director, \"data-bites\", bite)\n    report = create(director, \"reports\", \"factbook\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", report)\n\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bite}/unpublish\", {}).status_code == 303\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/reports/{report}/delete\", {}).status_code == 303\n\n    counts = dashboard_counts(director)\n    assert (counts[\"data-bite-draft\"], counts[\"data-bite-published\"]) == (\"1\", \"0\")\n    assert counts[\"report-total\"] == \"0\"\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_uses_the_glossary_labels(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    for label in (\"Data Bites\", \"Reports\", \"Draft\", \"Published\"):\n        assert label in {"parentUuid":"27769903-e383-46af-bd30-e5f10c6e7304","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e372a766-1a24-4c82-822f-cd4971523b5c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0167vhxkxDV4L6994n3Rbvzy","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"4898e79a-e634-4333-b204-77764fb8bd80","timestamp":"2026-09-29T15:12:02.305Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py","oldString":"    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:","newString":"    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:","originalFile":"\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\nvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n\nEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\nData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\nexports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. False if\n        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def list_all(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"1\", \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n\n    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n                (status, item_id),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":107,"oldLines":6,"newStart":107,"newLines":14,"lines":["     def list_all(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:","         return self._select(\"1\", \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\")"," ","+    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:","+        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.","+        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"","+        with db.connect() as conn:","+            rows = conn.execute(","+                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()","+        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}","+","     def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:","         return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"27769903-e383-46af-bd30-e5f10c6e7304","session_id":"fc138a42-1eee-4017-bff2-c6a77302f820","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"03dcb795-0379-4d2c-bdc0-cd9944628657","version":"2.1.284","gitBranch":"main"}

mixed_content(director: TestClient, analyst: TestClient) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Two Data Bites and two Reports, one of each published.\"\"\"\n    create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"bite-draft\")\n    publish(analyst, \"data-bites\", create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"bite-live\"))\n    create(analyst, \"reports\", \"report-draft\")\n    publish(director, \"reports\", create(analyst, \"reports\", \"report-live\"))\n\n\ndef test_content_list_shows_both_types_newest_first(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    mixed_content(director, analyst)\n    with db.connect() as conn:  # setup: make \"bite-draft\" the most recently updated\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE data_bites SET updated_at = '2999-01-01 00:00:00'\"\n                     \" WHERE slug = 'bite-draft'\")\n\n    rows = listed(analyst)\n    assert rows[0] == (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Draft\", \"Draft\")\n    assert sorted(rows) == [\n        (\"Data Bite\", \"Bite-Draft\", Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. False if\n        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def list_all(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"1\", \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n\n    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n\n    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. preview_of(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The inside of the page's preview area.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'<div class=\"content-preview\"[^>]*>(.*?)</div><!-- /content-preview -->',\n                      html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no preview on the page\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef assert_inert(preview: str) -> None:\n    assert \"<script\" not in preview and \"owned\" not in body}, with_csrf=with_csrf)\n\n\ndef test_editing_a_data_bite_shows_its_rendered_markdown(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"retention\", <strong>92%</strong></li>\" in shown\n\n\ndef test_editing_a_report_shows_its_rendered_markdown(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    rid = create(analyst, \"reports\", \"factbook\", test_the_new_item_forms_have_a_preview_too(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    for path in (\"/admin/data-bites\", \"/admin/reports\"):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/content\").text.count(\"content-row\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_a_failed_save_previews_what_was_typed(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_form(analyst, \"/admin/data-bites\",\n                         {\"title\": \"\", \"slug\": \"x\", \"body\": \"Unsaved *work*\"})\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"<em>work</em>\" in preview_of(response.text)\n\n\ndef test_a_script_payload_is_inert_in_the_data_bite_preview(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create(analyst, \"data-bites\", \"payload\", body=PAYLOAD)\n    assert_inert(preview_of(analyst.get(f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\").text))\n\n\ndef test_a_script_payload_is_inert_in_the_report_preview(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    rid = create(director, \"reports\", \"payload\", body=PAYLOAD)\n    assert_inert(preview_of(director.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text))\n\n\ndef test_a_script_payload_is_inert_in_the_live_preview(client_as):\n    assert_inert(preview(client_as(\"editor\"), PAYLOAD).text)\n\n\ndef test_the_body_is_stored_raw(client_as):\n    \"\"\"Sanitizing test_an_analyst_sees_a_locked_report_rendered(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    rid = create(analyst, \"reports\", \"factbook\", body=PAYLOAD)\n    publish(director, \"reports\", rid)\n    page = analyst.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text\n    assert 'action=\"/admin/reports/' + rid + '\"' not in page  # still read-only\n    assert_inert(preview_of(page))\n\n\ndef test_the_live_preview_needs_a_csrf_token(client_as):\n    assert preview(client_as(\"editor\"), \"hi\", with_csrf=False).status_code == 403\n\n\n# --- Anonymous visitors ---------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_anonymous_visitors_are_sent_to_login(client):\n    for path in (\"/admin\", \"/admin/content\", path\n    response = client.post(\"/admin/preview\", data={\"body\": \"hi\"}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert (response.status_code, response.headers[\"location\"]) == (303, \"/login\")\nEOF\nuv
